agent.problem: Moses appears here for the first time, but he is not simply identified. Saying only that he directed Joshua does not explain who he is, such as Israel's leader before Joshua.

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

agent.problem: This is the only card covering Joshua 4:23, and answering False establishes only that the comparison was not to the Sea of Galilee. No card ever tells the baker that the LORD had dried up the Red Sea, leaving out an important detail of the passage.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
